steps.name: Given real COMPANY credentials are available
And the real company user is signed in for magic-link testing
And the Firebase user has emailVerified set to false
When I generate a verification oobCode via test endpoint
When the extracted oobCode is checked via verify-reset-code
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-29T08:11:47.667","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/verify-reset-code","requestId":"REQ-41b9a79a","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the response messageKey should be "error.auth.invalid_action_code"

messageKey in: {"timestamp":"2026-10-29T08:11:47.667","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/verify-reset-code","requestId":"REQ-41b9a79a","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
When the password is reset via confirm-password-reset to "ValidPass1"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-29T08:11:47.682","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-495ec8e7","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the response messageKey should be "error.auth.invalid_action_code"

messageKey in: {"timestamp":"2026-10-29T08:11:47.682","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-495ec8e7","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the Firebase user has emailVerified set to true
